package postgres

import (
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestPinnedPlanningStoreAndMigrationContract(t *testing.T) {
	var _ repository.PinnedCoursePlanRepository = Store{}
	up, e := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/019_course_planning_input_checkpoint.up.sql")
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	down, e := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/019_course_planning_input_checkpoint.down.sql")
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	for _, required := range []string{"payload_bytes bytea", "payload_sha256=encode(sha256(payload_bytes)", "lease_until<=clock_timestamp()", "FOR UPDATE", "p->'intent' IS DISTINCT FROM r.intent_json", "IS TRUE", "BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE", "BEFORE TRUNCATE", "FOREIGN KEY(request_id,parent_hash)"} {
		if !strings.Contains(string(up), required) {
			t.Fatalf("missing migration guard %q", required)
		}
	}
	for _, required := range []string{"ACCESS EXCLUSIVE", "SELECT 1 FROM course_planning_input_checkpoint", "SELECT 1 FROM course_planning_generated_checkpoint", "SELECT 1 FROM course_planning_ensure_checkpoint", "cannot discard retained planning checkpoints"} {
		if !strings.Contains(string(down), required) {
			t.Fatalf("missing DOWN guard %q", required)
		}
	}
	if strings.Contains(string(up), "project_authoring_flow") {
		t.Fatal("019 depends on foreign authoring migration")
	}
}
